svg.title: Endet symbol — Geist geometry with Aeonik corner rounding
svg.desc: Geist skeleton preserved: 40-degree left tilt, 36-unit straight walls, no straight neck section. Circular fillets: outside R9, inside R11, concave neck R5. Two equal empty chambers, related by a 180-degree rotation. Transparent, single-path vector artwork, not a font glyph.
